learning_outcomes.title: Negative and zero exponents
learning_outcomes.statement: Simplify expressions containing negative and zero exponents.
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: For a≠0, a⁰=1 and a⁻ⁿ=1/aⁿ. Move only factors with negative exponents.
